transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just having trouble... keeping my mind on things. Like, at work. I build things, I'm a carpenter. But lately, if a saw starts up somewhere else, or someone walks by, or I just think about a different project... I get pulled away. And then the whole day is just gone.
Does this happen to you at home as well, or is it mostly at work?

It's... both. At home, my husband had to take over paying the bills and keeping track of things. I just kept misplacing the paperwork, or... missing what I was supposed to do. 

And at work, it's... well, the delays have cost me commissions. I've had to redo jobs because of mistakes. The rest of the crew doesn't really rely on me for the scheduling or ordering materials anymore. So... yeah. It's not just work.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

I suppose. Um... if I have to sit at a desk doing estimates, or... if I'm stuck in a long meeting. I get kind of... wound up inside. 

Like I just need to get up and move around. I know I’m supposed to just stay put and finish... especially since my wrist is healed now, but... yeah. I guess I do get restless.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Not really. I mean... I don't think so. I just... I do my work. I don't really do things without thinking, I just... have a hard time staying on the thing I'm supposed to be doing.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
I don't think so. I mean, I worry about falling behind at work, but... not generally anxious, no.
Do you have mood swings?
No. Not really. I mean... my mood is usually pretty steady, I guess. I don't really have big ups and downs. Just... normal, I think.
Do you have trouble organizing tasks and activities?

Yeah, I suppose. I mean... lately I've been stuck doing the shop paperwork, and... I don't know. I just can't seem to figure out what needs doing first. So... the bids, the schedules, invoices... even the apprentice questions, it all just kind of piles up on my bench. Then I'm rushing to get it done, and... I still end up missing deadlines.
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted when you're talking to someone or in a conversation?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... if a client or an inspector is talking right to me, I'll be looking at them, nodding along... but then I realize I missed half of what they said. I just... have to ask them to go over it again. Like I wasn't even there.
Do you ever find yourself so focused on a task that you lose track of everything else around you?
No. I don't think so. I mean... I don't really get like that. I'm usually just... trying to get through whatever's in front of me.
{"intent": "determine presence of hyperactivity", "question": "Do you often feel like you're "on the go" or like you're driven by a motor?"}
No, not really. I'm just... tired, mostly.
Have you noticed any problems in your relationships with friends or family due to your difficulties with focus or follow-through?

Yeah, I suppose so. Um... my husband mostly handles all the bills now. And the reminders. I just... I kept losing the papers, or forgetting what we needed to do. So he took over. And at work... well, I've had to redo things. Or I'll cause delays. I think the crew... they don't really trust me with ordering supplies or figuring out the schedule anymore. It's cost me a few jobs, too.
Did you have trouble paying attention or sitting still when you were a kid?

Yeah... I suppose so. Sitting still wasn't really the issue, but... paying attention, yeah. 

Even back in grade school... before I was 12, I think. Teachers were always telling my mom I was bright, but... careless. I was always losing my homework. Or I'd forget the instructions they just gave. I'd just... stare out the window instead of finishing my seatwork.
Would you say that your problems with paying attention and completing tasks were mild, moderate, or severe when you were in school?
I don't really know... severe, I guess. It was pretty bad. I barely made it through.
Do you have trouble focusing or following through on tasks when you're doing things you enjoy, like hobbies?
Um... no, not really. If it's something I actually like doing... I can usually stick with it just fine.
Were you ever diagnosed with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder as a child?
No... nobody ever said anything about a diagnosis back then. They just said I wasn't trying hard enough.
Have you experienced difficulties with focus or follow-through in social situations, like when you're with friends or in a group?
I guess I haven't really noticed that. I don't go out much anyway.
Do you have trouble focusing or following through on tasks at home, at work, and in other areas of your life?

Yeah... I suppose so. It's... it's been a problem at work. I've made mistakes, had to redo jobs... lost some commissions over it. The rest of the crew, they don't really want me handling the scheduling or ordering materials anymore. They'd rather just do it themselves. 

And at home... my husband handles the bills and all the reminders now. I kept misplacing the papers, or just missing what needed to get done. So he just took it over.
Would you say your current problems with paying attention and completing tasks are mild, moderate, or severe?
I don't know... severe, I guess. It affects pretty much everything.
Have you had problems with paying attention or following through on tasks for as long as you can remember?

Yeah... I guess so. 

Even back in grade school... like, before I was 12... I remember teachers always telling my mother I was bright, but... careless. I was always losing my homework or forgetting the instructions. I'd just... stare out the window instead of finishing my seatwork. So... yeah. It's been a long time.
